run_CseAnnotationsAccumulator_tests: run the unittest test suite for CseAnnotationsAccumulator to verify annotation packing and accumulation logic
test_accumulator_nodp: test CseAnnotationsAccumulator with instances that have no dense pose annotations attached
test_accumulator_sparsedp: test CseAnnotationsAccumulator with instances that have sparse dense pose data with None entries
test_accumulator_fulldp: test CseAnnotationsAccumulator with instances that have full dense pose data on all instances
test_accumulator_combined: test CseAnnotationsAccumulator with a combined mix of no-dp, sparse-dp, and full-dp instances
